sql_query:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    LEFT(o.order_id, 10) AS order_id_10,
    ABS(SUM(op.payment_value)) AS order_total_usd
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_payments AS op
    ON op.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE op.payment_value IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY LEFT(o.order_id, 10)
),
orders_with_sellers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    LEFT(oi.order_id, 10) AS order_id_10,
    LEFT(oi.seller_id, 10) AS seller_id_10
  FROM order_items AS oi
  WHERE oi.seller_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  r.role,
  AVG(ot.order_total_usd) AS avg_order_value_usd,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ot.order_id_10) AS order_count
FROM (
  SELECT 'customer' AS role, ot.order_id_10
  FROM order_totals AS ot
  UNION
  SELECT 'seller' AS role, ot.order_id_10
  FROM order_totals AS ot
  JOIN orders_with_sellers AS os
    ON os.order_id_10 = ot.order_id_10
) AS r
JOIN order_totals AS ot
  ON ot.order_id_10 = r.order_id_10
WHERE ot.order_total_usd IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.role
ORDER BY r.role;
